entities.name: Migingo Island
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Migingo is an island on Lake Victoria in Kenya. At only 2,000 m2, it is extremely densely populated. The island has been a low-level territorial dispute between Kenya and Uganda. Migingo's location makes it useful for Kenyan and Ugandan fishermen.
